name: Minority game: the memory transition
description: Savit, Manuca and Riolo's phase transition: σ²/N over the last 100 of 5 000 rounds against memory M for 51, 101 and 201 players with 2 strategies each. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-27): a minimum of 0.059, 0.060 and 0.061 at M 5, 6 and 7 — one memory step later per doubling of N, so the three curves are one curve in 2^M/N (minimum near 0.6); well above coin-flippers' 0.25 at small M (1.2, 2.0, 3.8 at M 1), back to about 0.25 by M 12. Reproduced.
